title: Live Wayland surface, ARSEM three-button acceptance, parser fuzzing, DAG assignment

scope.objective: Complete the 0.1 gate: real Wayland window with pointer events into goya-runtime; ARSEM three-button spatial acceptance proof; mutation fuzzing of the IR parser; explicit wave numbers for the deferred bucket.

implementation_record.notes: goya-wayland binds wl_compositor/wl_shm/wl_seat/xdg_wm_base, renders via memfd+wl_shm ARGB8888, maps pointer presses to runtime hit_test. Policy shift recorded: host layer uses official Smithay bindings; zero-dep policy retained for foundation crates. goya-layout spacers are now direction-aware (invisible in rows before). goya-buttons implements the GY-SON-001 section 7 first deliverable with programmatic verification of the directive's acceptance table.

results.live_hello: 600 frames presented, no protocol errors after v1-safe damage fix
results.buttons_acceptance: 9/9 PASS: left pan -0.502 (<-0.5), centre +0.008, right +0.518 (>0.5), depth ordering, mono fold-down audible, rate limit 30/100, NullOutput sink 1440/1440 samples, drag trajectory smooth (max delta 0.142), live 900 frames
results.fuzzer: 20,000 deterministic mutation inputs; totality + determinism + root-integrity asserted; first run found root-N dangling acceptance bug — fixed
results.known_environment_defect: doctests remain excluded (host rustdoc LLVM issue)

test_evidence.environment: rustc 1.95.0, Wayland session wayland-1, real compositor

notable_findings.spacer: GY-LAYOUT/1 spacer was vertical-only — invisible inside rows. ARSEM acceptance geometry required direction-aware semantics; fixed with a contract-compatible refinement + regression test.
notable_findings.wayland_versioning: damage_buffer requires wl_surface v4; bound compositor v1 made it a protocol error. Switched to v1-safe damage.
notable_findings.fuzz_first_catch: The parser accepted 'root N' with an undeclared N, violating the registered invariant; unit tests missed it, the fuzzer caught it on run one.

risk_assessment.wayland: Single fixed-size window; no resize/multi-buffer; acceptable for 0.1 scope and recorded as exclusions.
risk_assessment.audio: ARSEM output path verified through NullOutput sink; PipeWire adapter is wave 2a before any real-audio claim.
